paper.title: Knowledge Distillation from Large Reasoning Models to Compact Student Models: A Case Study on the John O Bryan Mathematics Competition
paper.abstract: This paper investigates knowledge distillation from a large reasoning model (DeepSeek-R1) to a compact student model (Qwen2.5-7B). Using historical problems from the John O'Bryan Mathematics Competition at Northern Kentucky University (2011-2025), we build a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) training corpus through a dual-agent framework. The dataset is used to fine-tune the student model with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on Apple Silicon hardware using the MLX framework. The base Qwen2.5-7B model achieves 6

summary.core_problem: 如何将DeepSeek-R1这类大推理模型的CoT能力通过知识蒸馏迁移到7B级小模型，并在小众数学竞赛数据集上验证效果与稳定性。
summary.importance: 属于后训练阶段的蒸馏案例研究，贡献了一套双Agent构造CoT语料的流程，以及小数据LoRA微调下过拟合与训练步数的经验观察。
summary.technical_approach: 采用双Agent框架从DeepSeek-R1教师模型生成John O'Bryan数学竞赛题的CoT推理链，构造蒸馏语料后对Qwen2.5-7B学生模型做LoRA微调；基于首次训练的过拟合曲线，将训练步数截断到200步并做多种子重复实验评估稳定性。
summary.experiments: 教师模型DeepSeek-R1在竞赛题上准确率91.40%，基线Qwen2.5-7B为64.67%；5次200步LoRA微调的平均准确率69.43%，标准差0.17%；1000步训练在200步后验证损失持续上升，出现严重过拟合。
summary.authors_note: 作者标注含DeepSeek机构关联，核心工作围绕DeepSeek-R1蒸馏展开。

summary_en.core_problem: How to distill Chain-of-Thought reasoning capability from a large reasoning model like DeepSeek-R1 into a 7B-scale student model, and validate effectiveness and stability on a niche mathematics competition dataset.
summary_en.importance: A case study in post-training knowledge distillation; contributes a dual-agent pipeline for constructing CoT corpora and empirical observations on overfitting vs. training steps under small-data LoRA fine-tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses a dual-agent framework to generate CoT reasoning traces for John O'Bryan Mathematics Competition problems from the DeepSeek-R1 teacher, builds a distillation corpus, then performs LoRA fine-tuning on the Qwen2.5-7B student; based on the overfitting curve of the first run, truncates training to 200 steps and runs multi-seed repeated experiments to assess stability.
summary_en.experiments: Teacher DeepSeek-R1 reaches 91.40% accuracy on competition problems, baseline Qwen2.5-7B reaches 64.67%; 5 runs of 200-step LoRA fine-tuning yield a mean accuracy of 69.43% with a standard deviation of 0.17%; the 1000-step run shows severe overfitting, with validation loss rising steadily after iteration 200.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is marked with DeepSeek affiliation and centers on distillation from DeepSeek-R1.

recommendation.zh: 小数据集LoRA蒸馏的案例，过拟合拐点观察有参考价值，但setup偏窄，仅作为后训练经验备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: A small-dataset LoRA distillation case; the overfitting inflection-point observation is mildly useful, but the setup is narrow — keep as post-training reference, skip the full text.

paper.title: Quantization Inflates Reasoning: Token Inflation as a Hidden Cost of Low-Bit Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Quantization is widely used to reduce the inference cost of large language models, but its effect on reasoning models is not fully captured by final-answer accuracy or per-token latency. We show that low-bit post-training quantization can introduce a hidden test-time compute cost: quantized reasoning models often generate longer chains of thought even when they still answer correctly. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, scientific question answering, and agentic tool-use benchmarks,

summary.core_problem: 现有低比特训练后量化（PTQ）的评估体系仅关注最终答案准确率和单token延迟，完全忽略了推理类LLM的核心成本变量——推理阶段生成的思维链（CoT）token数量；低比特PTQ会导致推理模型在正确率基本不变的情况下生成更长的推理轨迹，产生隐藏的端到端推理成本膨胀，抵消甚至超过量化带来的单token加速收益。
summary.importance: 该工作系统性揭示了量化与推理计算行为的耦合效应，填补了推理模型量化评估的关键盲区。对预训练-部署闭环的具体影响包括三点：1）推翻了“量化后正确率不变则部署成本降低”的默认假设，要求推理模型部署时必须测量端到端延迟，而非仅看单token速度；2）为后训练、量化感知训练（QAT）提出了新的优化目标——控制推理token开销，而非仅约束权重精度损失；3）对推理增强预训练（如R1类模型的训练）有间接启示：模型的推理长度偏好对权重的数值精度非常敏感，训练时的数值稳定性会直接影响部署时的推理成本。
summary.technical_approach: 1）定义核心指标CoT Token Inflation Ratio（CTIR）：量化模型与全精度基线在同一benchmark上的平均推理token数的比值，用于量化膨胀程度，计算时严格拆分推理token（<think>标签内或CoT段）与答案token，避免指标偏差。2）严格控制变量实验：设置temperature=0消除采样噪声，仅评估权重-only PTQ（隔离量化算法、激活量化等其他变量），覆盖4B到30B参数的dense、MoE两类推理架构，横跨数学、代码、科学问答、工具调用四类重推理任务，同时加入轻推理的通用语言benchmark作为对照组，验证膨胀效应的任务相关性。3）行为分析：对推理轨迹的语义重复度、中间步骤数量做统计，区分“冗余措辞”和“重复推理”两类膨胀来源，验证额外推理步骤对正确率无贡献。4）缓解策略评估：分别测试prompt调控（要求推理简洁）、解码约束（限制最大推理长度）、量化感知训练（QAT）三种方案的效果，对比其准确率-长度的trade-off。
summary.experiments: 评测模型包括Qwen3-4B-Thinking、Phi-4-14B（dense架构），Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking（MoE架构）；量化方法覆盖GPTQ、AWQ、SmoothQuant、ParoQuant等主流权重-only PTQ，位宽为INT4、INT3。核心结果：1）INT4/INT3量化在多数推理benchmark上最终答案准确率损失<2%（几乎无损），但CTIR可达1.15~1.4（推理token数增加15%~40%）；例如MoE模型的INT3量化在AIME25上准确率仅降0.3%，但CTIR达1.32。2）膨胀程度与任务推理强度正相关：轻推理的通用语言benchmark（HellaSwag、MMLU-Pro）的CTIR仅1.02~1.07，几乎无膨胀。3）行为层面：量化模型的推理轨迹中，语义重复片段占比提升8%~15%，中间验证步骤数量增加20%以上，这些额外步骤未带来正确率提升。4）缓解策略效果：prompt要求简洁仅在部分benchmark上降低CTIR，同时导致准确率下降3%~5%；解码硬截断推理长度会大幅降低正确率；QAT可将准确率损失控制在1%以内，同时将CTIR降到1.05以内，是当前最优的缓解方向。
summary.reading_guide: 精读优先级：1）第4章的核心实验结果表格，重点对比不同模型、不同量化位宽、不同任务下的CTIR与准确率变化，这是全文的核心实证依据；2）第6章的行为分析部分，明确膨胀的具体表现是重复推理而非冗余措辞，理解其对计算成本的实际影响；3）第5章CTIR的定义与计算细节，注意推理token与答案token的拆分逻辑，避免后续复现或使用时出现指标偏差；4）第7章的缓解策略对比，重点分析QAT能同时控制精度损失和token膨胀的内在原因。可跳过附录中具体量化算法的参数配置细节（除非从事量化工程落地）。值得深挖的方向：推理模型的数值精度如何影响其“终止推理、输出答案”的决策阈值，是否可以在预训练、RL训练阶段引入推理长度正则化，来提升模型的量化鲁棒性，从训练源头降低部署时的隐藏成本。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluation protocols for low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ) only track final-answer accuracy and per-token latency, completely ignoring a core cost variable for reasoning-optimized LLMs: the number of chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens generated at inference time. Low-bit PTQ can cause reasoning models to produce significantly longer reasoning trajectories while maintaining nearly unchanged answer accuracy, creating a hidden end-to-end inference cost inflation that offsets or even outweighs the per-token speedup from quantization.
summary_en.importance: This work systematically reveals the coupling effect between quantization and reasoning computational behavior, filling a critical blind spot in the evaluation of quantized reasoning models. Its concrete impacts on the pretraining-deployment loop include three points: 1) It overturns the default assumption that "unchanged accuracy after quantization equals lower deployment cost", requiring end-to-end latency measurement (instead of per-token speed only) for reasoning model deployment. 2) It proposes a new optimization target for post-training and quantization-aware training (QAT): controlling reasoning token overhead, rather than only constraining weight precision loss. 3) It provides indirect implications for reasoning-enhanced pretraining (e.g., R1-style model training): a model's reasoning length preference is highly sensitive to weight numerical precision, so numerical stability during training directly affects inference cost at deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Define the core metric CoT Token Inflation Ratio (CTIR): the ratio of the average number of reasoning tokens generated by a quantized model versus its full-precision baseline on the same benchmark, used to quantify inflation degree. Calculation strictly splits reasoning tokens (within <think> tags or CoT segments) and answer tokens to avoid metric bias. 2) Strict controlled variable experiments: set temperature=0 to eliminate sampling noise, evaluate weight-only PTQ only (to isolate variables like quantization algorithm and activation quantization), cover dense and MoE reasoning architectures with 4B to 30B parameters, span four reasoning-heavy task categories (mathematics, code generation, scientific QA, agentic tool use), and add light-reasoning general language benchmarks as control groups to verify the task correlation of inflation. 3) Behavioral analysis: quantify semantic repetition rate and number of intermediate steps in reasoning trajectories, distinguish two inflation sources (redundant wording vs repeated reasoning), and verify that extra reasoning steps contribute nothing to accuracy. 4) Mitigation strategy evaluation: test three approaches respectively (prompt regulation for concise reasoning, decoding constraints on maximum reasoning length, QAT) and compare their accuracy-length trade-offs.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated models include Qwen3-4B-Thinking, Phi-4-14B (dense), and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking (MoE). Quantization methods cover mainstream weight-only PTQ approaches including GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, ParoQuant, with bit widths INT4 and INT3. Core results: 1) INT4/INT3 quantization introduces <2% final-answer accuracy loss (nearly lossless) on most reasoning benchmarks, but CTIR reaches 1.15–1.4 (15%–40% increase in reasoning tokens). For example, INT3 quantization on the MoE model reduces AIME25 accuracy by only 0.3% but reaches a CTIR of 1.32. 2) Inflation degree positively correlates with task reasoning intensity: CTIR for light-reasoning general language benchmarks (HellaSwag, MMLU-Pro) is only 1.02–1.07, with negligible inflation. 3) Behavioral findings: quantized models show 8%–15% higher proportion of semantically repeated segments in reasoning trajectories, and the number of intermediate verification steps increases by over 20%, with these extra steps bringing no accuracy improvement. 4) Mitigation performance: Prompting for conciseness only reduces CTIR on a subset of benchmarks, while causing 3%–5% accuracy drop; hard truncation of reasoning length severely hurts accuracy; QAT keeps accuracy loss within 1% while suppressing CTIR to below 1.05, making it the most promising mitigation direction.
summary_en.reading_guide: Priority reading order: 1) Core experimental result tables in Section 4, especially the comparison of CTIR and accuracy changes across models, quantization bit widths, and tasks — this is the core empirical evidence of the paper. 2) Behavioral analysis in Section 6, to clarify that inflation manifests as repeated reasoning rather than redundant wording, and understand its actual impact on computational cost. 3) CTIR definition and calculation details in Section 5, especially the split logic between reasoning tokens and answer tokens, to avoid metric bias in reproduction or application. 4) Mitigation strategy comparison in Section 7, focus on the internal reason why QAT can simultaneously control precision loss and token inflation. Skip appendix sections on specific quantization algorithm parameter configurations (unless working on quantization engineering deployment). Worth deeper exploration: How numerical precision of reasoning models affects their decision threshold for "terminating reasoning and outputting answers", and whether reasoning length regularization can be introduced during pretraining or RL training to improve model quantization robustness, reducing hidden deployment costs from the training source.

recommendation.zh: 量化reasoning模型的'准确率不掉=没事'被打脸：token变长直接吞掉端到端加速，立刻在内部Serving测算里复现这个指标。
recommendation.en: Kills the naive 'accuracy preserved, speedup achieved' story for quantized reasoning models—token inflation eats the wall-clock win; add this metric to your serving eval now.

paper.title: CALIBER: Calibrating Confidence Before and After Reasoning in Language Models
paper.abstract: Reasoning language models are increasingly asked not only to answer difficult questions, but also to estimate their likelihood of success. Existing methods typically elicit confidence only once: either before thinking or after answering. We argue that confidence in reasoning models is state-dependent: before thinking, confidence should estimate the chance of the model correctly solving the prompt, while after thinking it should predict whether the realized answer is likely to be correct. This di

summary.core_problem: 解决推理模型在“思考前”和“作答后”置信度估计混为一谈，导致校准目标错配的问题。
summary.importance: 这是后训练与评估交界处的工作，贡献是把置信度校准拆成两个信息状态下的不同任务。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它提醒我们，模型内部状态变化后，监督目标也应随之变化，不能把所有 uncertainty 都压成一个标量。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 CALIBER，分别在看到 prompt 后、以及完成 reasoning/answer 后各 elicitation 一次 confidence。前者用 prompt-level success 作为监督目标，估计“这道题我能不能做对”；后者用 answer-level correctness 作为监督目标，估计“我刚给出的这个答案对不对”。核心不是新架构，而是统一协议下的信息状态匹配监督。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 CALIBER 相比只在单一时刻估计置信度的方法，将 Expected Calibration Error 降低 52.5%。任务对象是 reasoning language models，但摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集名称和 baseline 列表；从描述看，比较对象主要是只在思考前或只在作答后做一次 confidence elicitation 的现有做法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a target-mismatch problem in confidence estimation for reasoning models: confidence before thinking and confidence after answering are treated as the same task when they should not be.
summary_en.importance: This sits at the boundary of post-training and evaluation. Its main contribution is to split calibration into two tasks tied to two information states. For pretraining researchers, the useful lesson is that supervision targets should track the model's state; uncertainty should not always be collapsed into a single scalar prediction.
summary_en.technical_approach: CALIBER elicits confidence twice: once after seeing the prompt and once after producing reasoning/answer. The first is supervised with prompt-level success, estimating whether the model can solve the problem; the second is supervised with answer-level correctness, estimating whether the realized answer is correct. The novelty is not architectural but in state-matched supervision under a unified protocol.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 52.5% reduction in Expected Calibration Error relative to single-shot confidence baselines. The target setting is reasoning language models, but the abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or the exact baseline suite; the comparison appears to be against methods that elicit confidence only before or only after reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 更像后训练校准小修正，不会改变 pretrain prior；如果你在做 verifier、selective generation 或 RL 置信度奖励，只看“双时刻、双监督目标”这个设定就够了。
recommendation.en: This is a neat post-training calibration fix, not a pretraining prior shift; if you work on verifiers, selective generation, or confidence-based rewards, the only thing to take is the two-state, two-target setup.

paper.title: DART: Draft-Agreement Routing for Training-Free Adaptive Thinking Budgets in Hybrid Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Hybrid reasoning models can answer directly or spend extra tokens on extended thinking. A practical router should choose between these modes for each query, so easy problems avoid unnecessary reasoning and hard problems receive enough budget to finish the answer. Existing routers move in this direction, but they typically require labeled training data or fix thinking budgets up front, ignoring answer-level evidence from the model itself. We introduce DART, a training-free routing framework that

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 hybrid reasoning model 的推理预算分配问题：简单问题不应总是进入长思考模式，困难问题又需要足够预算完成推理和最终答案。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏推理与服务策略，不是预训练方法。它对基座研究的启发在于模型自身生成的短答案一致性可以作为难度和置信度信号。相比训练一个 router，DART 使用 NoThink draft 的一致性做决策，降低了对标注难度数据、模型特定微调和闭源接口权限的依赖。它也提醒评测 reasoning model 时要区分思考 trace 和最终答案的截断问题，否则 always-thinking baseline 可能被生成上限低估。
summary.technical_approach: DART 是一个无训练的两阶段路由框架。第一阶段 SC-Route 对同一问题采样 K 个 NoThink draft，论文主设定使用 K=2。系统先抽取每个 draft 的答案，再用任务相关的 equivalence function 判断是否等价。如果两个 draft 的答案一致，就直接接受 NoThink 答案；如果不一致，则认为该问题需要 Think 模式。第二阶段只作用于 disagreement cases：当模型提供 token log-probability 和可控 thinking budget 时，DART 用 draft entropy 预测查询级预算，把更多 token 分给不确定性更高的问题。这个设计的取舍很明确：Stage 1 只依赖文本输出，适合 API-only 模型；Stage 2 能进一步省 token，但需要更强的接口能力。
summary.experiments: 论文在 Qwen3 8B 到 32B 以及 DeepSeek-V3.2 上评估。作者报告，在主要比较中，DART 的准确率通常可以持平或超过 always-thinking，同时减少 thinking token。数学任务上，DART 在部分设置中相对 always-thinking 最高提升 9.0 个百分点，并减少 15% 到 69% 的 thinking token。代码任务中，在 execution-based equivalence 下，最高提升 22.5 个百分点，并减少 51% 到 63% 的 thinking token。监督 router 诊断实验显示，draft unanimity 比 entropy 或 draft length 更能预测 always-thinking 是否会答对。论文还指出，单次调用中把 reasoning trace 和 final answer 放在同一个生成上限下，会让 always-thinking 因答案未完整输出而被低估，附录 C 专门量化了这一评测伪差。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看方法部分的 Algorithm 1、SC-Route 的 K=2 unanimity 设计、answer extraction 与 equivalence function 的定义。实验部分重点看 token saving 与 accuracy 的 trade-off 表，以及数学和代码任务中 DART 相对 always-thinking 的结果。附录 C 值得快速看，因为它涉及 reasoning model 评测协议：如果思考和答案共享同一个 generation cap，结论可能混入截断效应。若关心 serving，可进一步看 Stage 2 的 entropy-to-budget 映射；若只关心 API 可用方案，Stage 1 已经是主要贡献。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies adaptive inference for hybrid reasoning models: the system should answer easy queries directly, while allocating enough thinking budget to queries that genuinely need extended reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-time routing paper, not a pretraining contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model research is the use of the model’s own short no-think drafts as a difficulty signal. DART avoids labeled difficulty data and model-specific router training, and it works with text-only APIs for its first stage. The paper also makes a useful evaluation point: always-thinking baselines can be underestimated when the reasoning trace and final answer share a tight generation cap.
summary_en.technical_approach: DART has two stages. Stage 1, SC-Route, samples K no-think drafts for the same query, with K=2 as the main setting. It extracts the answer from each draft and checks agreement using a task-specific equivalence function. If the drafts unanimously agree, DART accepts the direct answer. If they disagree, the query is routed to Think mode. Stage 2 applies only to routed queries. When log probabilities and budget controls are available, DART maps draft entropy to a query-specific thinking budget, giving more tokens to higher-uncertainty cases. The design separates a broadly usable text-only routing signal from an optional budget-allocation module that requires richer model access.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates DART on Qwen3 models from 8B to 32B and on DeepSeek-V3.2. In the main reported comparisons, DART often matches or exceeds always-thinking accuracy while using fewer thinking tokens. On math tasks, the best reported point estimate is a 9.0-point accuracy gain with 15% to 69% fewer thinking tokens. On code tasks, using execution-based answer equivalence, the reported gain reaches 22.5 points with 51% to 63% fewer thinking tokens. A supervised-router diagnostic finds that draft unanimity is more predictive than entropy or draft length. The paper also analyzes a truncation artifact in single-call evaluations, where extended reasoning can consume the generation cap before the final answer is emitted.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Read Algorithm 1 and the SC-Route section first, especially the strict unanimity rule, answer extraction, and equivalence checking. Then inspect the main accuracy-versus-token tables for math and code. Appendix C is useful for anyone evaluating reasoning models, because it explains how a shared generation cap can distort always-thinking baselines. For deployment use, focus on the entropy-to-budget mapping in Stage 2. For API-only use, Stage 1 is the central mechanism.

recommendation.zh: 这是干净的 test-time budget heuristic；先看 draft agreement 失败样例，若鲁棒可直接进内部 serving ablation。
recommendation.en: This is a clean test-time budget heuristic; read the draft-disagreement failure cases first, and if robust, it belongs in an internal serving ablation.

paper.title: ADaPT: Token-Level Decoupling for Efficient Large Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models rely on long chain-of-thought to achieve strong performance, but applying such reasoning uniformly incurs high computational cost. Existing efficiency-oriented methods attempt to shorten or mix reasoning strategies, yet often degrade reasoning capability. We identify the root cause as sequence-level coupling between efficiency incentives and correctness optimization, which implicitly penalizes long but correct reasoning trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Adapt

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 reasoning model 的效率训练冲突：如果把“答对”和“少生成 token”都作为 sequence-level 奖励，训练会系统性压低长但正确的推理轨迹，导致深推理能力受损。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对 RLVR 和 reasoning post-train 的奖励设计有启发。关键点是把效率信号从完整答案上移开，避免让长度惩罚污染 correctness optimization。这个思路也提醒基座训练研究：当训练信号同时包含能力目标和成本目标时，标量化奖励很容易改变模型的解题分布，而不只是改变平均长度。
summary.technical_approach: ADaPT 引入一个显式的 mode-selection token，用来选择 fast reasoning 或 slow reasoning。训练分两阶段。第一阶段 SFT，让模型见到两类行为：短路径快速回答，以及带长 CoT 的慢速推理。第二阶段用 token-level 版本的 GRPO 做强化学习。核心设计是：正确性奖励仍作用于答案质量，效率相关奖励只作用于 mode-selection token，而不是惩罚整条序列。这样，模型可以学习什么时候触发慢思考，但不会因为某条长 CoT 是长的就降低其正确性学习信号。推理时可以调节触发 <think> token 的概率，让同一个模型在效率和性能之间连续移动。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在多个 reasoning benchmark 上验证 ADaPT 能显著减少推理 token 成本，同时保持较强的推理性能。可确认的实验设置包括基于 GRPO 的 RL 阶段、fast/slow 双模式训练，以及通过 <think> 触发概率控制效率—性能折中。当前给出的正文片段没有包含具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、token reduction 比例或准确率数字，因此不宜补造定量结论。实验部分最应关注的是：ADaPT 与 sequence-level length reward、hybrid reasoning baseline 的对比；长题与短题分桶结果；以及调节 mode token 概率后是否形成稳定 Pareto 曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看方法部分对 sequence-level coupling 的分析，以及 token-level GRPO 如何只把效率奖励施加到 mode-selection token。实验表格只需要抓三类数字：平均生成长度、主 benchmark 准确率、不同难度题目的性能变化。若只关心 pretrain，可重点读奖励解耦的思想，不必深挖具体应用 benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets an efficiency–capability conflict in large reasoning models. When correctness and brevity are optimized at the sequence level, long but correct chains of thought are implicitly penalized, which can weaken deep reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training and RLVR paper, not a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model training is the reward-design lesson: cost objectives should not be naively scalarized with capability objectives when the two act on different parts of the generation process. A length penalty applied to the whole sequence changes the learned reasoning distribution, not just the average token count.
summary_en.technical_approach: ADaPT introduces an explicit mode-selection token that chooses between fast and slow reasoning. Training has two stages. The SFT stage exposes the model to both short fast responses and longer slow CoT-style reasoning. The RL stage uses a token-level variant of GRPO. The key design is to apply efficiency-related rewards only to the mode-selection token, while preserving correctness optimization for the answer. This decouples the decision to think slowly from the learning signal for whether the reasoning is correct. At inference time, the probability of triggering the <think> token can be adjusted, allowing one model to trade off compute and accuracy without retraining.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks, with the main claim that ADaPT reduces inference cost while maintaining strong reasoning performance. The visible technical setup includes a GRPO-based RL stage, fast/slow dual-mode supervision, and inference-time control through the <think> trigger probability. The provided text does not expose the concrete benchmark list, model sizes, token-reduction ratios, or accuracy numbers, so the quantitative claims should be checked in the experiment tables. The important comparisons are against sequence-level length rewards and hybrid reasoning baselines, with separate attention to easy versus hard problems and to whether the mode-token probability produces a smooth Pareto curve.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the analysis of sequence-level coupling and the token-level GRPO objective, especially where the efficiency reward is attached only to the mode-selection token. In the experiments, look for three numbers: average generated tokens, reasoning accuracy, and performance by problem difficulty. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main transferable idea is reward decoupling; the benchmark-specific details are secondary.

recommendation.zh: 值得看奖励拆分的 setup；若实验干净，应把“效率惩罚只打到控制 token”放进内部 RLVR ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the reward-decoupling setup; if the experiments are clean, the control-token-only efficiency penalty deserves an internal RLVR ablation.

paper.title: GraphPO: Graph-based Policy Optimization for Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for enhancing the capability of large reasoning models. RLVR typically samples responses independently and optimizes the policy using from final answers. This paradigm has two limitations. First, independently responses often contain similar intermediate reasoning steps, causing redundant exploration and wasted computation. Second, sparse final-answer rewards make it hard to identify useful steps. Tree-based met

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLVR 中独立采样导致推理轨迹重复探索、最终答案奖励过稀疏、树搜索又无法跨分支共享相似状态的问题。
summary.importance: 这是后训练阶段针对 reasoning model 的 RL 方法改进。它不直接改 pretrain，但对“如何给长链推理提供更低方差、更细粒度训练信号”有现实启发，属于 pretrain↔post-train 接口上值得关注的工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GraphPO，把推理过程从独立样本或树结构扩展为图结构优化。核心动机是：不同分支可能到达相似 reasoning state，图比树更适合共享信息。方法上利用图结构聚合相近中间状态，并在图上做更细粒度的比较与 advantage 估计，以降低方差、减少重复探索。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和提升幅度，但明确对比对象包括标准 RLVR 和 tree-based 方法。主要实验主张是：GraphPO 能更有效利用相似中间状态，缓解稀疏奖励和重复探索问题。若正文有 clean ablation，重点应看图构建准则、状态相似度定义以及 advantage 估计稳定性。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表中包含 Jingdong Chen、Jun Zhou，通常与工业研究团队相关；但仅凭摘要无法稳妥确认具体机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two RLVR bottlenecks for reasoning models: redundant exploration from independently sampled trajectories and sparse final-answer rewards, while tree-based methods still fail to share information across similar states reached from different branches.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training RL paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it matters at the pretrain–posttrain interface because it studies how to provide lower-variance, more fine-grained learning signals for long-chain reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: GraphPO extends reasoning optimization from independent samples or trees to graph-structured policy optimization. The key idea is that different branches can converge to similar reasoning states, and a graph can share information across them. The method aggregates similar intermediate states and performs finer-grained comparison and advantage estimation on the graph to reduce variance and avoid repeated exploration.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact gains, but the comparison targets clearly include standard RLVR and tree-based methods. The main empirical claim is that GraphPO uses similar intermediate states more efficiently, mitigating sparse rewards and redundant exploration. In the full paper, the most important parts to inspect would be graph construction, state similarity, and the stability of advantage estimation.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Jingdong Chen and Jun Zhou, which suggests an industry research team, but the exact institution cannot be confirmed from the abstract alone.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作对 pretrain 的价值在训练信号设计，不在 RL 包装；先看它如何定义“相似 reasoning state”，若这一步不干净，后面收益大概率站不住。
recommendation.en: Its value for pretraining researchers is in training-signal design, not the RL wrapper; inspect how it defines similar reasoning states first, because the rest depends on that being clean.

paper.title: Dynamic Rollout Editing for Reducing Overthinking in RL-Trained Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Long-form chain-of-thought reasoning can improve LLM performance on complex tasks, but models often continue generating unnecessary reasoning after a correct answer has emerged. We refer to this behavior as overthinking. We study this phenomenon from the perspective of GRPO-style reinforcement learning (RL) post-training, framing it as a training-time credit-assignment problem rather than merely a decoding-time stopping problem. In rollouts sampled at the onset of GRPO training, we observe that

summary.core_problem: 在 GRPO 这类序列级奖励的 RL post-train 中，模型一旦在 chain-of-thought 里“已经出现可验证正确答案”，后续继续生成冗余推理（overthinking）会被和“到达正确答案的前缀”一起获得正向 credit，从而被训练过程系统性强化。论文要解决的不是解码时怎么停，而是训练时的 credit assignment：如何在不伤害到达正确答案的推理前缀的前提下，削弱成功轨迹中答案出现之后那段冗余 token 的偏好信号。
summary.importance: 把“过度思考”从 decoding/长度控制问题，改写成 GRPO/序列级优势函数带来的结构性训练偏差，并给出一个可落地的训练期干预。对推理模型的 post-train recipe 有直接影响：如果你的 verifier 能定位答案出现点，DRE 这类编辑式偏好学习可以在基本不掉准确率的情况下显著降长度与算力成本，并减少训练后期形成的“反复检查/重复验证/答案回看”模式。更重要的是，它提供了一个通用视角：当 reward 只在序列末端给出且更新对整段轨迹同权时，任何“成功后仍继续生成”的行为都可能被错误归因并固化。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是 Dynamic Rollout Editing (DRE)：
1) 让“答案出现”可观测：对每条 rollout，用 parser 抽取中间答案候选，并用外部 verifier 判定正确性，定义最早可验证正确答案出现的位置作为 answer emergence point。这样能把轨迹分成“到达答案的前缀”和“答案后冗余段”。
2) 训练期编辑成功轨迹：当一条成功轨迹在 answer emergence 之后仍有明显 overthinking，构造一个 edited counterpart：保留从开头到一个保守边界（围绕 emergence 点，避免误删必要 token）的 verified prefix，把后续 overthinking 替换/截断为更短的版本（目标是保留正确答案并去掉冗余）。
3) 在同一个 GRPO group 内做相对偏好：把原成功轨迹与 edited 轨迹放在同组比较，让 edited 轨迹获得更高 preference/优势，从而把“成功”的正向信号更多分配给短轨迹，弱化‘成功=长且反复检查’的耦合。
4) 两个训练细节用于避免误伤前缀并稳定学习信号：
- Prefix masking：对原轨迹与 edited 轨迹共享的 verified prefix 不施加负向更新，避免因为偏好 edited 而把到达答案所需的前缀也压下去。
- GClip：在编辑点附近给更可控的学习信号（论文将其作为对 edited tokens/边界处梯度的稳定化手段），避免“硬截断”导致的局部不连续训练效应。
与常见替代方案的差异：
- 不是 length penalty：长度惩罚会同时压制有用推理与无用推理，且对不同题型的最优长度不一致。
- 不是 stopping controller/early-exit：那些方法在策略学成后再控长度；DRE 直接改训练信号，阻断反馈回路。
- 不是对整条成功轨迹降权：那会削弱到达答案的关键前缀；DRE 通过“保前缀、改后缀”的编辑把 credit 分离。
summary.experiments:
全文宣称覆盖数学推理、科学 QA、代码生成等任务，结论集中在两点：
- 长度主要在 answer emergence 之后被削减：DRE 的长度收益不是靠缩短必要推理，而是减少答案出现后的冗余段（反复检查、重复验证、答案回看）。
- 性能基本保持：在保持任务成功率/准确率接近 vanilla GRPO 的同时，显著降低平均生成长度与推理成本，并在不同任务上复现。
给出的机制性证据是：GRPO 训练早期，同一 prompt 下成功轨迹在答案出现后往往比失败轨迹更“长一点”，这个微小偏差在序列级优势更新下会被放大，形成 overthinking 的自增强回路；DRE 通过组内偏好把这个回路切断。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含具体表格数字、模型规模、数据量与提升幅度；若需要精确数值，需要对照论文的实验表与附录。）
summary.reading_guide:
精读优先级：
- 先看“Overthinking After Answer Emergence”的定义与 parser-verifier 标注流程：它决定了 DRE 是否可迁移到你的任务（能否稳定抽取并验证中间答案）。
- 重点看 GRPO credit assignment 的分析图/统计：成功轨迹在 emergence 后更长的早期偏差，以及训练过程中如何被放大。
- 再看 DRE 的编辑边界策略与两项训练技巧（prefix masking、GClip）：这里是工程可复现的关键，尤其是如何避免误删必要 token、如何处理编辑点附近的梯度不稳定。
- 实验部分建议按“长度分解（emergence 前/后）→ 任务成功率保持 → 不同任务泛化”顺序读，确认收益是否来自正确的段落（答案后）而不是牺牲推理质量。
预计阅读时间：60–90 分钟（含把方法映射到自己 verifier/数据管线的思考）。

summary_en.core_problem: In GRPO-style RL post-training with sequence-level rewards, a rollout can contain both (i) the reasoning prefix that reaches a verifiably correct answer and (ii) redundant tokens generated after the answer has already emerged. Because GRPO assigns the same positive advantage to the whole successful trajectory, it cannot separate credit between these two parts, and it may systematically reinforce “overthinking after answer emergence”. The paper targets this as a training-time credit-assignment issue rather than a decoding-time stopping problem.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a concrete diagnosis of why overthinking can get amplified during GRPO training, plus a training-time intervention that reduces post-answer verbosity without sacrificing task success. Practically, if you can reliably detect the earliest verifiable answer point (via parsing + external verification), the proposed editing-based preference signal can lower inference cost and curb common failure patterns like repeated checking and answer revisiting. Conceptually, it highlights a broader RLHF/RL-posttrain pitfall: whenever reward is terminal and updates are trajectory-level, any behavior that co-occurs with success after the goal is achieved can be inadvertently reinforced.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Dynamic Rollout Editing (DRE) has three pillars:
1) Make “answer emergence” observable: for each sampled trajectory, parse intermediate outputs to extract an answer candidate and use an external verifier to find the earliest position where a correct answer can be verified. This splits tokens into a necessary prefix vs. post-answer continuation.
2) Edit successful overthinking rollouts: when a successful rollout contains substantial continuation after emergence, construct an edited counterpart that preserves a conservative verified prefix up to a safe boundary around the emergence point, and replaces/truncates the remaining overthinking segment while keeping the correct answer.
3) Rewire the GRPO preference within the same group: place the original and edited trajectories in the same GRPO group and prefer the shorter edited one, so the positive learning signal is less coupled with post-answer verbosity.
Two training stabilizers are introduced:
- Prefix masking: avoid directly penalizing the shared verified prefix, preventing degradation of the reasoning needed to reach the answer.
- GClip: provide a controlled learning signal around the edit boundary to mitigate instability caused by hard edits near the cut point.
Key difference from alternatives: it is not a global length penalty (which can suppress useful reasoning), and not a post-hoc stopping controller (which does not change what RL reinforces). It explicitly changes the training signal to decouple success from post-answer continuation.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports consistent gains across math reasoning, science QA, and code generation: generation length is reduced primarily after the answer emergence point, while task performance remains close to vanilla GRPO. The mechanistic evidence is that early in GRPO training, successful rollouts for the same prompts already exhibit slightly more post-emergence continuation than unsuccessful ones; sequence-level advantages then amplify this bias over training. DRE breaks this feedback loop by shifting preference toward edited shorter counterparts.
(Note: the provided full-text excerpt does not include the numeric tables/model sizes; exact deltas require checking the main experiment tables and appendix.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read in this order:
- The formal definition and measurement pipeline for answer emergence (parser + verifier). This determines whether DRE is applicable to your domain.
- The analysis section that quantifies the early success/length imbalance and explains how GRPO’s trajectory-level advantage mixes credit.
- The DRE algorithm details: how the conservative boundary is chosen, what exactly is replaced after the edit point, and how prefix masking + GClip are implemented.
- Experiments: focus on length decomposition (pre- vs post-emergence), performance retention, and cross-task robustness.
Time budget: ~60–90 minutes if you also map it to your own verifier/data pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现它的 rollout 诊断；若成立，长 CoT RL 的长度偏置不是解码小毛病。
recommendation.en: Replicate the rollout diagnostics quickly; if it holds, length bias in long-CoT RL is not just a decoding nuisance.

paper.title: Unlocking LLM Code Correction with Iterative Feedback Loops
paper.abstract: Large Language Models have shown remarkable capabilities in code generation. However, most existing evaluations focus only on single-attempt accuracy and overlook the iterative refinement process that is central to real-world programming. This study presents a systematic investigation of LLMs' ability to rectify their own code through execution feedback. Using real-world programming problems across four models and two major programming languages, this study evaluates performance using iterative

summary.core_problem: 如何系统评估 LLM 在接收编译器错误和测试用例反馈后，通过迭代修正自身代码的能力？
summary.importance: 提出了一种评估框架和指标，将代码生成的评估从单次尝试准确率扩展到更符合真实编程场景的迭代修正过程，并对比了推理模型和非推理模型在反馈循环中的表现差异。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一个迭代修正框架，LLM 在每次尝试后接收编译器错误信息和测试用例反馈。引入了评估代码失败、分析修正模式的指标，并在四种模型（包括推理和非推理模型）和两种主要编程语言上使用真实编程问题进行评估。
summary.experiments: 在四种模型和两种编程语言上进行实验。结果表明，推理模型在迭代过程中持续改进，显著优于非推理模型，强调了反馈循环在 LLM 驱动的代码生成系统中的重要性。

summary_en.core_problem: How to systematically evaluate the ability of LLMs to iteratively correct their own code after receiving compiler errors and testcase feedback?
summary_en.importance: Proposes an evaluation framework and metrics that extend code generation evaluation from single-attempt accuracy to an iterative refinement process more aligned with real-world programming, comparing the performance differences between reasoning and non-reasoning models in feedback loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs an iterative refinement framework where LLMs receive compiler error messages and testcase feedback after each attempt. Introduces metrics to evaluate code failures and analyze rectification patterns, and evaluates performance using real-world programming problems across four models (including reasoning and non-reasoning models) and two major programming languages.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments conducted on four models and two programming languages. Results show that reasoning models consistently improve over iterations, substantially outperforming non-reasoning models, highlighting the importance of feedback loops in LLM-driven code generation systems.

recommendation.zh: 验证了 reasoning model 在接收 execution feedback 后自我修正能力更强，作为 evaluation setup 备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Confirms reasoning models are better at self-correction given execution feedback; keep as evaluation setup reference, skip the main text.

paper.title: ReQAT: Achieving Full-Precision Reasoning Accuracy with 4-bit Floating-Point Quantization-Aware Training
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong problem-solving through long chain-of-thought, but their deployment is constrained by the high cost of full-precision inference and growing KV cache footprints. Microscaled FP4 formats enable efficient FP4 deployment; however, fully quantizing weights, activations, and KV caches (W4A4KV4) causes severe reasoning degradation that existing PTQ and QAT fail to recover. We identify that FP4 failures concentrate on low-entropy tokens--precise symbolic comm

summary.core_problem: 解决大型推理模型在 W4A4KV4 的 FP4 全量量化下推理能力明显下降的问题，尤其是长 CoT 中错误会级联放大。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率和量化训练方法创新。它把 FP4 失效定位到低熵 token，例如数字、运算符和确定性符号承诺，这比只报告平均精度下降更接近可操作的误差机制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReQAT，一个面向推理轨迹的 FP4 QAT 框架。核心包括 Trace-Aligned QAT，让模型反复访问相同推理轨迹以集中修复关键低熵决策；Selective Entropy Minimization，在低熵位置增强置信度；Q-FIT，用更适合量化的初始化或适配流程降低 FP4 噪声敏感性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模和 benchmark 数字。实验目标是 W4A4KV4，即权重、激活和 KV cache 都使用 4-bit 浮点量化；论文声称相比现有 PTQ 和 QAT，ReQAT 能恢复接近全精度的 reasoning accuracy，并缓解低熵符号位置的采样错误级联。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the severe reasoning degradation of large reasoning models under full FP4 quantization, especially W4A4KV4 quantization across weights, activations, and KV cache.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and quantization-training contribution. Its useful part is the diagnosis that FP4 failures concentrate on low-entropy tokens such as digits, operators, and precise symbolic commitments, rather than being uniform noise.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReQAT is a reasoning-centric FP4 QAT framework. It uses Trace-Aligned QAT to revisit identical reasoning traces and focus updates on critical low-entropy decisions, Selective Entropy Minimization to sharpen confidence at those positions, and Q-FIT to initialize or adapt the model in a quantization-friendly way.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, training data, or benchmark details. The evaluated setting is W4A4KV4 FP4 deployment, quantizing weights, activations, and KV cache. The paper claims ReQAT recovers near full-precision reasoning accuracy where prior PTQ and QAT fail.

recommendation.zh: 只看低熵 token 失效分析和 TAQ/SEM 消融；若数字任务成立，FP4 推理不该再按平均误差建模。
recommendation.en: Read the low-entropy token failure analysis and TAQ/SEM ablations; if the math-task evidence holds, FP4 reasoning should not be modeled by average quantization error.

paper.title: Forecasting Future Behavior as a Learning Task
paper.abstract: Trust in an AI system is often anchored by explanations of how it works, which one then uses to forecast its behavior on new inputs. For large reasoning models (LRMs), this conventional route is particularly difficult to follow: explanation methods for single token generations do not naturally generalize to long trajectories, and the trajectories themselves are often not faithful when read as natural language. We propose an alternative that bypasses the explanation step: treat behavior forecasti

summary.core_problem: 对大型推理模型，传统“先解释再预测行为”的路线很难扩展到长推理轨迹，因此作者把行为预测本身当作一个可学习任务。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析与可解释性方向的工作，贡献不在改模型，而在提出一种不依赖人工标注、直接预测模型未来行为的分析框架。
summary.technical_approach: 训练 Behavior Forecaster：输入单条 reasoning trajectory，单次前向就预测模型在其他条件下的行为。训练数据通过反复查询目标 LRM 自动构造，无需人工标注。文中实例化了两个任务：重跑时是否会重复答案，以及删去部分输入后答案是否改变。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明在两个任务上评估该方法，并与基于解释的替代路线比较；但未给出模型规模、数据量和具体提升数字。更像分析工具而非能力方法。

summary_en.core_problem: For large reasoning models, explanation-first approaches do not scale well to long trajectories, so the paper reframes behavior forecasting itself as a learnable task.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic-analysis and interpretability contribution rather than a model-improvement paper, proposing a way to predict future model behavior without human labels.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper trains a Behavior Forecaster that takes a single reasoning trajectory and predicts how the target LRM would behave under alternative conditions in one forward pass. Training data is generated automatically by querying the LRM itself. Two instantiations are studied: answer repeatability across reruns and answer changes under input ablations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates evaluations on both tasks and comparisons against explanation-based alternatives, but it does not provide model sizes, dataset scale, or quantitative margins. It reads more like an analysis tool than a capability method.

recommendation.zh: 不是训练方法，但对“轨迹可解释性不可信”这个问题给了更实用的替代物；先看它如何构造无标注训练信号，再决定要不要深读。
recommendation.en: Not a training paper, but it offers a practical alternative when trajectory explanations are untrustworthy; inspect the label-free supervision setup first.

paper.title: ReasonAlloc: Hierarchical Decoding-Time KV Cache Budget Allocation for Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Long chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories in large language model (LLM) reasoning cause severe inference bottlenecks due to rapid key-value (KV) cache growth. Current decoding-time compression methods mitigate this issue via token eviction, but typically assume a uniform budget distribution across all layers and heads. In contrast, existing non-uniform budget allocation methods are predominantly designed for the static prompt prefill phase, and they do not capture the stepwise context demands of

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 reasoning model 在长 CoT 解码时 KV cache 快速增长的问题。已有 decoding-time KV 压缩方法主要决定“删哪些 token”，但通常给所有层和 attention heads 分配近似均匀的预算；作者指出，推理模型不同层、不同 head 对历史 KV 的需求并不均匀，统一预算会让关键路径被过度压缩。
summary.importance: 这是一篇推理效率论文，对预训练研究的启发在于：RL 后的 reasoning model 可能形成和普通 LM 不同的注意力资源分布。长推理不是简单的长上下文，cache 需求会随层、head、生成步变化。对基座研究员来说，这类分析有助于理解 reasoning-oriented post-training 如何改变模型内部使用上下文的方式，也能反馈到架构设计、attention allocation、长上下文训练和 serving-aware training。
summary.technical_approach: ReasonAlloc 把 decoding-time KV cache compression 改写为层级预算分配问题，而不是只做 token eviction。第一层是离线 layer-wise preallocation：作者通过真实生成阶段的 attention 分布估计每层为了保留给定比例 attention mass 所需的 token 数，并归一化成层级预算比例。他们称这种相对稳定的层级需求模式为 Reasoning Wave。第二层是在线 head-wise routing：在每个解码阶段，根据各 head 当前的 utility 波动，把层内预算分配到不同 heads。ReasonAlloc 是 training-free 的，可以包在已有 eviction policy 外面，例如 R-KV。R-KV 的 token scoring 同时考虑历史 attention importance 和 novelty，用来避免 CoT 中大量重复文本占据 cache；ReasonAlloc 则负责把总预算更合理地分到层和 head。与 PyramidKV、DynamicKV 这类主要面向 prefill 的非均匀分配不同，ReasonAlloc 针对 autoregressive reasoning 的逐步生成特性设计，不假设固定的单调衰减预算曲线。
summary.experiments: 作者先在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill 系列模型上分析 KV 需求异质性，包括 R1-Llama-8B、R1-Qwen-14B 和 R1-Qwen-7B；任务覆盖 MATH-500、AIME 2024、LiveCodeBench 和 LongBench。需求度量不是简单平均 attention，而是对历史 token 按 attention 权重排序，找到累计 attention mass 达到阈值 ρ 所需的最小 token 数，再转成每层相对预算。主实验在 MATH-500 和 AIME 2024 上使用 R1-Llama-8B、R1-Qwen-14B 和 AceReason-14B。结果显示，在相同压缩率下，ReasonAlloc 优于均匀预算和固定非均匀预算 baseline；收益在小 cache budget 时更明显，额外推理开销很小。给定内容没有提供完整数值表，因此不应把改进幅度解读为已知固定数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读。先看 Section 3 的 KV demand heterogeneity 分析，尤其是用 attention mass 阈值 ρ 定义层级需求的方法；这是论文最有信息量的部分。然后看 ReasonAlloc 的 layer-wise offline calibration 和 online head-wise router，理解它为什么比静态 prefill 分配更适合 CoT 解码。实验部分重点看小预算区间、Pyramid-RKV 对照、不同 reasoning models 上的稳定性。预计阅读 25–40 分钟。若只关心 serving，可直接看算法伪代码、压缩率设置和 overhead；若关心 reasoning model 机制，则优先读 Reasoning Wave 的可视化与跨任务稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV-cache growth during long chain-of-thought decoding in reasoning models. Existing decoding-time cache compression methods mostly decide which tokens to evict while allocating roughly uniform budgets across layers and heads. The paper argues that this uniform allocation is mismatched to reasoning models, where different layers and attention heads require very different amounts of retained context.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in inference efficiency, but it also gives useful signals for pretraining and post-training research. RL-tuned reasoning models may use context in a distribution that differs from standard language models: cache demand varies by layer, head, and decoding step. That observation is relevant for long-context training, attention architecture choices, serving-aware model design, and analysis of how reasoning post-training changes internal computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReasonAlloc treats decoding-time KV compression as hierarchical budget allocation. At the layer level, it performs offline calibration during actual generation. For each layer, tokens are sorted by attention weight, and the method measures the minimum number of historical tokens needed to preserve a target fraction rho of the attention mass. These raw demands are normalized into a layer-wise budget profile, described as a relatively stable Reasoning Wave. At the head level, ReasonAlloc uses an online router to allocate each layer’s budget across heads according to their current utility during autoregressive decoding. The method is training-free and wraps existing token eviction policies such as R-KV. R-KV scores tokens using both attention importance and novelty, which helps avoid keeping redundant CoT tokens; ReasonAlloc complements it by deciding how much budget each layer and head should receive. Unlike prefill-oriented methods such as PyramidKV-style static schedules, it is designed for stepwise decoding rather than a fixed prompt-only allocation.
summary_en.experiments: The paper first profiles heterogeneous KV demand in DeepSeek-R1-Distill models, including R1-Llama-8B, R1-Qwen-14B, and R1-Qwen-7B, over MATH-500, AIME 2024, LiveCodeBench, and LongBench. The main evaluation uses R1-Llama-8B, R1-Qwen-14B, and AceReason-14B on MATH-500 and AIME 2024. At the same compression ratios, ReasonAlloc outperforms uniform-budget baselines and fixed non-uniform allocation baselines, with the largest gains under small cache budgets. The reported inference-time overhead is negligible. The provided text does not include full numeric tables, so the safe takeaway is the trend and the experimental setup rather than a specific improvement percentage.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper with focus on the KV-demand profiling section and the definition based on preserving a target attention-mass threshold. That is the most useful part for understanding why uniform cache budgets fail. Then read the layer-wise offline calibration and online head-wise routing mechanisms. In the experiments, focus on the small-budget regime, the Pyramid-RKV comparison, and consistency across reasoning models. A 25–40 minute read should cover the main content. For serving work, prioritize the algorithm, compression settings, and overhead; for model analysis, prioritize the Reasoning Wave visualizations and cross-task stability claims.

recommendation.zh: 针对长 CoT 推理的 KV Cache 优化，提出了非均匀的层级/头级动态分配策略，揭示的“Reasoning Wave”现象对理解长推理模型的内部机制有启发。
recommendation.en: Addresses KV cache optimization for long CoT reasoning with a non-uniform, hierarchical dynamic allocation strategy; the identified 'Reasoning Wave' phenomenon is insightful for understanding the inner workings of reasoning models.

paper.title: Predicting Future Behaviors in Reasoning Models Enables Better Steering
paper.abstract: Deployed large reasoning models (LRMs) often behave unexpectedly. Test-time steering controls LRM outputs by intervening on their hidden representations, but it can degrade output quality. We argue that prior steering work implicitly relies on internal features that detect behavior in already generated text. We show that these detection features are poor predictors of future behavioral outcomes, and thus not the natural intervention target. Instead, we train activation probes to predict future b

summary.core_problem: 解决推理模型在测试时 steering 常依赖“已生成行为的检测特征”，因此控制不准且容易伤害输出质量的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作把 steering 目标从事后检测改成对未来行为的前瞻预测，属于机制分析和干预接口设计；对理解 reasoning model 内部表征、以及 post-train 信号如何映射到可控生成，有实质启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先训练 activation probes，从中间 reasoning steps 预测未来行为发生的概率，发现模型内部存在一类独立于事后检测特征的“prediction features”。在此基础上提出 Future Probe Controlled Generation：对多个候选句子打分，选择最可能导向目标未来行为的候选，从而在文本层面完成 steering，而不是直接改 hidden state。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 probes 对未来行为的预测准确率为 64%-91%，并声称 FPCG 在几乎不降低输出质量的情况下实现更稳的 steering。实验重点应是对比传统 activation steering / detection-based steering 的行为控制效果与质量退化，但摘要未给出具体模型规模。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单包含 Sebastian Lapuschkin、Wojciech Samek，属于可解释性与表征分析方向较活跃的一支团队。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode in test-time steering of reasoning models: prior methods rely on features that detect behavior already present in generated text, making control inaccurate and quality-degrading.
summary_en.importance: It reframes steering from post-hoc detection to forward-looking behavior prediction, which is useful for understanding internal representations in reasoning models and for designing cleaner intervention interfaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors train activation probes on intermediate reasoning steps to predict the likelihood of future behaviors, identifying internal 'prediction features' distinct from detection features. They then propose Future Probe Controlled Generation, which samples multiple candidate sentences and selects the one most likely to lead to the desired future behavior according to the probe.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 64%-91% accuracy for predicting the most likely future behavior and claims that FPCG achieves steering with almost no output-quality degradation. The setup likely compares against standard activation-steering or detection-based baselines, though model sizes are not specified in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Sebastian Lapuschkin and Wojciech Samek, a team known for interpretability and representation analysis.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“可控性特征”从检测改成预测，这个接口定义值得借到 reasoning/post-train；先看 probe 结果和对比质量退化那张表。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the shift from detection features to prediction features is a clean conceptual move worth importing into reasoning/post-train; read the probe results and the quality-retention table.

paper.title: When Built-in Thinking Helps and Hurts: Constraint-Level Error Shifts in Instruction Following
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) often improve math and coding performance, but their effect on instruction following is unclear. We study IFEval with Qwen3 models (1.7B-32B), using same-weights Thinking ON/OFF controls; four Hunyuan models provide directional cross-family support. Aggregate pass-rate changes are small (-0.55 to -3.52 pp), yet 10-20% of prompts switch between pass and fail across modes, suggesting that thinking changes the pattern of errors--some prompts improve while others worsen

summary.core_problem: 分析 reasoning / thinking 模式对 instruction following 的影响，尤其是它是否只是整体提高或降低 IFEval 表现，还是改变不同约束类型的错误分布。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和评测诊断。它用 same-weights Thinking ON/OFF 控制减少模型差异干扰，指出 thinking 对指令遵循的影响主要体现为 constraint-level error shift，而不是单一方向的平均分变化。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Qwen3 1.7B 到 32B 上切换 Thinking ON/OFF，并用四个 Hunyuan 模型做跨家族方向性验证。作者对 IFEval 约束做 post-hoc 分组，将全局计数、结构、协调等归为 Planning，将精确局部格式归为 Precision，再比较各类约束在 thinking 模式下的得失；同时做长度匹配分析，排除 final-answer length 变化的部分混淆。
summary.experiments: 主要实验使用 IFEval、Qwen3 1.7B-32B same-weights 控制，以及四个 Hunyuan 模型。Qwen3 aggregate pass-rate 在 Thinking ON 下小幅下降约 0.55 到 3.52 个百分点，但 10%-20% prompts 在两种模式间发生 pass/fail 翻转。Planning 类约束在 thinking 下改善，Precision 类约束稳定变差；该方向性模式在 Hunyuan 模型上也成立，尽管 Hunyuan 的总分方向不同。
summary.authors_note: 摘要标注该工作与 Hunyuan 相关，并使用 Hunyuan 系列模型做跨家族验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how built-in thinking affects instruction following, asking whether it changes aggregate IFEval scores uniformly or shifts errors across constraint types.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanism and evaluation analysis. By using same-weight Thinking ON/OFF controls, it argues that thinking mainly causes constraint-level error shifts rather than a simple average improvement or degradation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study toggles Thinking ON/OFF in Qwen3 models from 1.7B to 32B and uses four Hunyuan models for directional cross-family support. It groups IFEval constraints post hoc into Planning, covering global counting, structure, and coordination, and Precision, covering exact local form. It also performs matched-length analyses to separate length effects from thinking effects.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use IFEval, same-weight Qwen3 models from 1.7B to 32B, and four Hunyuan models. For Qwen3, aggregate pass rate changes are small, from -0.55 to -3.52 percentage points, but 10-20% of prompts switch pass/fail status between modes. Planning constraints improve under thinking, while Precision constraints consistently worsen; the sign pattern holds directionally for Hunyuan models despite opposite aggregate movement.
summary_en.authors_note: The metadata marks the work as related to Hunyuan, and the study uses Hunyuan models for cross-family validation.

recommendation.zh: 读 constraint 分组和长度匹配分析；它会修正“thinking 只会帮或害 IF”的粗粒度 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the constraint grouping and length-matched analysis; it corrects the coarse prior that thinking simply helps or hurts instruction following.

paper.title: OPRD: On-Policy Representation Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises the student only in output space by matching next-token probabilities. This output-only paradigm has two limits: (1) sampling variance from Monte Carlo KL estimates over large vocabularies (e.g., Qwen's ~150k tokens) persists throughout training, and (2) it treats the teacher as a black-box, discarding all intermediate hidden states after the LM head. We propose On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD), which lifts distillation into hidden-state space

summary.core_problem: 解决 on-policy distillation 只在输出概率空间蒸馏时存在的高方差、信息利用不足和大词表训练低效问题。
summary.importance: 这是后训练蒸馏方向里较有信息量的一篇：它不是再做 top-k logits 拟合，而是把 on-policy 蒸馏搬到隐藏状态空间，直接挑战“输出分布匹配就够了”的常见做法。对理解 teacher-to-student 信号质量、推理模型压缩和 RL 后训练后的能力迁移都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OPRD（On-Policy Representation Distillation）。核心做法是在同一条 on-policy rollout 上，对齐 teacher 与 student 的若干层隐藏表示，而不是通过 LM head 匹配 next-token 概率。作者声称这样可以绕开大词表 Monte Carlo KL 估计带来的采样方差，同时保留更丰富的层级结构信息。方法上属于对现有 OPD 的目标函数替换与训练信号重构，而不是全新训练范式。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告在 AIME 2024/2025 和 AIMO 上，OPRD 能进一步缩小 student-teacher gap，而输出空间 OPD baseline 会在低于 teacher 的位置停滞。效率方面，OPRD 相比 top-k OPD 训练速度提升 1.44 倍、显存占用降低 54%。摘要未给出模型参数量、teacher/student 规模、训练 token 数和具体 baseline 名称，这些需要看正文确认 setup 是否干净。
summary.authors_note: 浙江大学团队。摘要未显示业界广泛知名作者，但主题贴近当前推理模型蒸馏与后训练压缩。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the variance, information bottleneck, and inefficiency of output-space on-policy distillation, especially under very large vocabularies.
summary_en.importance: This is a useful post-training distillation paper because it does more than another top-k logit matching tweak: it moves on-policy distillation into hidden-state space and directly questions the common assumption that matching output distributions is sufficient. That matters for teacher-to-student signal quality, reasoning-model compression, and transferring capabilities from RL-tuned teachers.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes OPRD, or On-Policy Representation Distillation. Instead of matching next-token probabilities through the LM head, the student aligns selected hidden layers with the teacher on the same on-policy rollouts. The claimed benefit is eliminating Monte Carlo KL sampling variance over large vocabularies while preserving richer layerwise structural information. Methodologically, this is a redesign of the distillation target rather than a new training paradigm.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, OPRD narrows the student-teacher gap on AIME 2024/2025 and AIMO, while output-space OPD baselines plateau below the teacher. It also reports 1.44x faster training and 54% lower memory than top-k OPD. The abstract does not specify model sizes, teacher/student scales, training tokens, or exact baselines, so the cleanliness of the setup needs verification in the main paper.
summary_en.authors_note: From Zhejiang University. No widely recognized marquee author is evident from the metadata, but the topic is closely aligned with current reasoning-model distillation and post-training compression.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但它在蒸馏信号上动了真刀：若你在做 RL 后 teacher 压缩，先看隐藏层对齐是否真比 logit 匹配稳，重点查 ablation 和 rollout 设定。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it makes a real move on distillation signal design: if you compress RL-tuned teachers, check whether hidden-state alignment is genuinely cleaner than logit matching, especially the ablations and rollout setup.

paper.title: Value-Aware Stochastic KV Cache Eviction for Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Reasoning models improve accuracy through extended chains of thought, but their long outputs create a memory and compute bottleneck. KV cache eviction methods reduce this cost by evicting unimportant key-value pairs from the cache, yet they often yield worse accuracy than selection-based sparse attention alternatives, which keep the full KV cache. We identify key factors crucial to KV cache eviction accuracy. First, a small fraction of value states have abnormally large magnitudes, and evicting

summary.core_problem: 推理模型在生成超长思维链时，KV cache 随序列长度线性增长，造成严重的显存与计算瓶颈。现有 eviction 方法（永久丢弃不重要 KV 对）在推理任务上精度下降显著，往往不如保留完整 cache 的 selection 类稀疏注意力方法。
summary.importance: 揭示了 KV cache 管理中两个被忽视的关键因素——value 向量幅值分布的极端偏态性，以及随机性在 eviction 中的正面作用。对推理服务的工程落地有直接参考价值，也提示了 attention value 统计特性可能是预训练动态分析的一个有用窗口。
summary.technical_approach: VaSE 是一个无需训练的 eviction 策略，建立在两个观察之上：(1) value 向量幅值呈强偏态分布，极少数大幅值 value 对精度至关重要，驱逐它们会导致模型陷入重复推理循环；(2) 在 eviction 中引入随机性能提高保留 KV 的多样性，从而提升精度。具体做法：用 value 向量的 L2 范数作为重要性评分，优先保留大幅值 value；在评分中加入随机扰动（stochastic gumbel-max 采样）增加多样性。采用周期性 eviction 框架：分为永久缓存 K 个 token + 最近 B 个 token 的 buffer。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-14B 上评测，覆盖数学、代码、科学 QA 共 6 个任务。相比之前最优 eviction 方法 R-KV，VaSE 平均提升 4.4%（4B）和 4.9%（14B）。与 CurDKV 结合时结合时，随机采样额外分别再提升 7.7% 和 9.2%。在静态显存预算下，精度甚至略超过内存随序列线性增长的 selection 方法 SeerAttention-R。在 GSM8K 上单 value 评分贡献 16.2% 提升，随机性额外贡献 4.7%。同时实测了吞吐量和峰值显存，验证与理论压缩比基本吻合。此外还将 insight 推广到 KV 量化场景，证明大幅值 value 在 per-token 量化下也造成不成比例的重建误差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。重点看 Figure 2（value 幅值分布直方图）和 Figure 9（evicting 大幅值 value 导致的失败案例）。阅读约 15-20 分钟。技术贡献主要看 method 方法与消融实验（Section 3-4）。
summary.authors_note: 机构作者信息未在文中明确标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Reasoning models generate extremely long chains of thought, causing KV cache to grow linearly with sequence length, creating a severe memory and compute bottleneck. Existing eviction methods (permanently discarding unimportant KV pairs) degrade accuracy notably on reasoning tasks, underperforming selection-based sparse attention that keeps the full cache.
summary_en.importance: Uncovers two underappreciated factors in KV cache management: the extremely skewed value magnitude distribution and the benefit of stochasticity in eviction. Offers a train-free recipe that directly improves reasoning service engineering, and also suggests that value statistics may be a useful lens for analyzing pretraining dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: VaSE is a training-free eviction strategy built on two observations: (1) value vector magnitudes are strongly skewed—a tiny fraction of large-magnitude values are critical to accuracy; evicting them triggers repetitive reasoning loops; (2) injecting stochasticity into eviction improves diversity of retained KV pairs. Specifically, VaSE uses L2 norm of value vectors as importance score, prioritizing large-magnitude values, and adds stochastic perturbation (Gumbel-max sampling) to increase diversity. Adopts a periodic-eviction framework with a persistent budget of K tokens plus a small buffer B of most recent tokens.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-14B across 6 tasks spanning math, code, and science QA. VaSE outperforms prior SOTA eviction method R-KV by 4.4% (4B) and 4.9% (14B) on average. When combined with CurDKV, stochastic sampling further boosts accuracy by 7.7% and 9.2% respectively. Under static memory budget, VaSE even slightly exceeds selection method SeerAttention-R whose memory grows linearly with sequence length. On GSM8K, value scoring alone contributes 16.2% improvement and stochasticity adds another 4.7%. Throughput and peak memory benchmarks closely match theoretical compression ratios. The insight also generalizes to KV quantization: large-magnitude values cause disproportionate reconstruction error under per-token quantization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Figure 2 (value magnitude distribution histogram) and Figure 9 (failure cases from evicting large-magnitude values). Estimated reading time 15-20 min. Method and ablation are in Sections 3-4.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliation not explicitly stated in the paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看§3对大幅值value状态的现象分析即可，方案是免训练的推理侧优化，对预训练侧的直接参考有限。
recommendation.en: Only read Section 3 for the analysis of large-magnitude value states. This is a training-free inference optimization with limited direct implications for pretraining.

paper.title: Extreme Low-Bit Inference in Reasoning Models: Failure Modes and Targeted Recovery
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) rely on long reasoning traces, making inference expensive. While low-bit quantization reduces per-token decoding cost, we show that aggressive 2-bit inference can fail to deliver end-to-end speedup because instability in the generation process inflates total token count. Instead of merely lowering answer accuracy, 2-bit quantization often produces much longer traces with repetitive loops, budget exhaustion, delayed commitment, and unclosed reasoning segments. We ana

summary.core_problem: 推理大模型的2比特等极低比特量化方案的效果退化机制缺乏清晰认知，现有评估仅关注最终答案准确率，混淆了量化、提示词格式、解码策略等多种变量的影响，无法定位低比特推理的具体故障点；同时推理过程中累积的量化误差对长推理轨迹的影响尚未被系统性分析。
summary.importance: 明确了极低比特量化对推理模型的损伤并非主要来自任务求解能力下降，而是推理过程的动态行为异常，为推理模型的压缩优化和预训练阶段的量化感知训练提供了具体的优化靶点，打破了“量化精度下降仅源于权重表示误差”的传统认知。
summary.technical_approach: 采用控制变量实验设置，固定提示词、解码策略、生成长度预算等变量，仅对比FP16、W4A16、W2A16 GPTQ量化的效果差异；除最终答案准确率外，引入推理长度、触发生成上限比例、think标签闭合率、首个答案出现位置、循环率等5个推理轨迹级指标，拆分量化故障为两类：路径寻找失败（进入循环前未生成有效答案）、提交失败（生成有效答案后未停止推理而是重复验证/重述）。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-32B两个规模的模型上测试，覆盖数学、常识推理共8个基准；2比特量化下，准确率下降伴随推理轨迹稳定性明显下降，循环率、触发生成上限比例上升，think标签闭合率下降；小模型（8B）的轨迹退化程度远大于大模型（32B）；准确率下降幅度与轨迹退化指标高度相关，更长的推理输出在2比特量化下多为非生产性的重复推理而非有效探索；两类故障在2比特量化下均被显著放大，小模型的故障覆盖几乎所有基准，大模型的故障集中在AIME、MATH、GPQA等高难度推理任务。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章推理轨迹分析部分和对应的图表，第4章的故障模式分类；泛读实验设置和生成长度预算的影响分析，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The degradation mechanism of extreme low-bit quantization such as 2-bit for large reasoning models lacks clear understanding. Existing evaluations only focus on final answer accuracy, confound the effects of multiple variables including quantization, prompt formatting, and decoding strategies, and cannot locate specific failure points of low-bit reasoning. Meanwhile, the impact of accumulated quantization errors during inference on long reasoning trajectories has not been systematically analyzed.
summary_en.importance: This work clarifies that the damage of extreme low-bit quantization to reasoning models does not mainly come from reduced task-solving ability, but from abnormal dynamic behavior of the reasoning process. It provides specific optimization targets for compression optimization of reasoning models and quantization-aware training during pretraining, breaking the traditional perception that "quantization accuracy degradation only originates from weight representation errors".
summary_en.technical_approach: A controlled experimental setup is adopted, with fixed variables including prompts, decoding strategies, and generation length budgets, only comparing the performance differences between FP16, W4A16, and W2A16 GPTQ quantization. In addition to final answer accuracy, five reasoning trajectory-level metrics are introduced: reasoning length, hit-limit rate, think-closed rate, time to first answer (TTFA), and loop rate. Quantization failures are split into two categories: path-finding failure (no valid answer generated before entering loops) and commitment failure (failure to stop reasoning after generating a valid answer, instead repeating verification or restatement).
summary_en.experiments: Tests are conducted on Qwen3 models at two scales, 8B and 32B, covering 8 mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks. Under 2-bit quantization, accuracy drops are accompanied by significantly reduced reasoning trajectory stability, with increased loop rate and hit-limit rate, and decreased think-closed rate. The trajectory degradation of the smaller 8B model is far more severe than that of the 32B model. The magnitude of accuracy drop is highly correlated with trajectory degradation metrics; longer reasoning outputs under 2-bit quantization are mostly unproductive repeated reasoning rather than effective exploration. Both failure modes are significantly amplified under 2-bit quantization, with failures in the small model covering almost all benchmarks, while failures in the large model are concentrated on high-difficulty reasoning tasks such as AIME, MATH, and GPQA.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 3 for reasoning trajectory analysis and corresponding figures, and Chapter 4 for failure mode classification. Skim the experimental setup and analysis of generation budget impact, with an estimated reading time of 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了长推理模型在极低比特量化下特有的 'token 膨胀/死循环' 失效模式，对后训练和推理部署极具启发，建议重点看其失效模式分析。
recommendation.en: Reveals the unique 'token inflation/infinite loop' failure modes of long reasoning models under extreme low-bit quantization; highly inspiring for post-training and inference deployment. Focus on the failure mode analysis.

paper.title: An Enigma of Artificial Reason: Investigating the Production-Evaluation Gap in Large Reasoning Models

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：大推理模型会生成长链推理，不代表它会可靠地判断一段推理是否有效。作者用“答案正确但推理无效”的 VAIR 数据集，把最终答案正确性和推理过程有效性拆开，专门测模型是否真的在评估推理链。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练都有直接启发。当前 reasoning model 很多能力来自 outcome-based RL，即奖励主要看最终答案。这会让模型学到“先自己解题，再用答案匹配来判断解法”的捷径，而不是学习逐步验证。论文的价值不在于提出新训练算法，而在于把 verifier / judge / reward model 的一个关键盲点暴露得比较干净：如果评测或奖励信号只和答案强相关，模型可能在过程监督上形成系统性偏差。对过程奖励模型、self-verification、RL 数据构造和推理评测设计都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是构造 Valid-Answer-Invalid-Reasoning 数据。给定数学题和标准解法，作者人为注入推理错误，同时保持最终答案仍然正确。错误类型包括四类：缺失题目前提，使原解法依赖未给出的信息；删除关键推理步骤，使链条中断；打乱推理步骤，破坏逻辑依赖；用模型生成循环或空洞推理，让结论看起来到达正确答案但没有有效论证。数据来自 GSM8K、MATH，并加入 Process-Bench 中较新的样本来降低污染风险。修改后的样本经过人工核验。评测时，模型不能靠“答案对不对”判断解法质量，因为答案和推理有效性被刻意解耦。作者还用了三类分析手段解释失效原因：CoT 文本分析显示模型经常先复现正确答案，然后忽略或合理化错误步骤；线性探针显示模型激活中有一定推理有效性信息，但对 VAIR 无法稳定编码为无效；因果 patching 说明最终答案表征会显著影响模型的判定，替换相关表征可以让 verdict 和激活状态翻转。
summary.experiments: 关键结果是生产能力和评估能力之间存在明显断裂。论文报告，前沿 LRM 在直接解题时准确率接近或超过 90%，在答案正确性和推理有效性一致的常规评估中也表现较好；但在 VAIR 上，部分模型评估准确率低至约 48%，会把近一半带有简单推理错误的解法判为无误。人类对照实验中，受试者直接解题准确率约 81%，评估 VAIR 解法准确率约 75%，只下降 6 个百分点。这个对比说明问题不是任务天然难以评估，而是当前 LRM 的训练和推理策略更偏向答案确认。消融和机制分析的重点在于 answer confirmation bias：模型看到正确答案后，倾向用自己能得到同一答案这一事实替代对推理链的逐步检查。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。先看 VAIR 构造部分，重点是四类扰动如何保证“答案有效但推理无效”；再看主结果表，确认生产准确率、常规评估准确率和 VAIR 评估准确率之间的差距；最后看解释性分析，包括 CoT 案例、linear probe 和 causal patching。对做 RLHF/RLAIF、过程监督、verifier 或 LLM-as-judge 的研究者，最值得细看的是数据设计逻辑：它避免了答案正确性这个强混杂因素，比普通“判断解法对错”的 benchmark 更能测到过程验证能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether large reasoning models can evaluate reasoning, not just produce it. It isolates this question with VAIR, a dataset where the final answer is valid but the reasoning chain contains simple logical flaws.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is to reasoning training and verifier design. Many current LRMs are trained with outcome-oriented reinforcement learning, where the reward is dominated by final answer correctness. This paper shows a failure mode of that setup: a model may learn to confirm an answer rather than validate the reasoning process. The result matters for process reward models, self-verification, LLM-as-judge setups, and the design of RL data where the quality of the training signal depends on detecting invalid intermediate steps.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors construct the Valid-Answer-Invalid-Reasoning dataset by perturbing math problem-solution pairs while preserving the correct final answer. The perturbations cover missing premises, missing reasoning steps, shuffled reasoning order, and circular or vacuous reasoning generated with an LLM. Seed problems are mainly drawn from GSM8K and MATH, with additional examples from Process-Bench to reduce contamination risk, and the modified samples are manually checked. The evaluation prevents the model from using final answer correctness as a proxy for reasoning quality. To explain the failure, the paper combines chain-of-thought analysis, linear probing, and causal patching. The qualitative traces show models often reproduce the correct answer and then rationalize the flawed solution. Probes suggest some validity information exists in activations, but it is not robustly used on VAIR. Patching answer-related representations can flip both verdicts and internal states, supporting an answer-confirmation-bias explanation.
summary_en.experiments: The reported gap is large. Frontier LRMs solve the underlying math problems with around 90% or higher accuracy, and they do well when answer correctness and reasoning validity agree. On VAIR, however, some models score as low as about 48%, marking invalid solutions as flawless up to roughly half of the time. Human participants show a much smaller gap: about 81% accuracy when solving and 75% when grading VAIR solutions. The mechanism experiments point to final-answer representations as a causal driver of the incorrect judgments.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30–45 minutes. Read the VAIR construction carefully, especially how each perturbation breaks reasoning without changing the answer. Then inspect the main accuracy comparison between direct solving, normal evaluation, and VAIR evaluation. The most useful parts for pretraining and post-training researchers are the interpretability analyses: CoT failure cases, linear probes, and causal patching. They clarify why answer-based supervision can produce weak process validation.

recommendation.zh: 推理能力机制的关键分析，重点关注gap成因拆解部分，对设计推理预训练目标有直接参考价值
recommendation.en: Key analysis of reasoning mechanism, focus on gap cause breakdown section, has direct reference value for designing reasoning pretraining objectives

institutions: Singapore-MIT Alliance for Research and Technology (SMART)

paper.title: Mitigating Adaptive Attacks against Reasoning Models with Activation Consistency Training
paper.abstract: As LLMs gain stronger reasoning capabilities, their extended chain-of-thought introduces new degrees of complexity for defending against adversarial jailbreaks and prompt injection. We study consistency training, a family of fine-tuning objectives that enforce identical behavior on clean prompts and adversarial rewrites, and evaluate its two main variants, output-level (BCT) and activation-level (ACT), across five reasoning models. We formulate both methods as a prompt injection defense and find

summary.core_problem: 具备长链式思维（CoT）的推理模型在对抗性越狱和prompt注入攻击面前呈现出新的脆弱性——CoT本身成为了攻击渠道（如H-CoT、CoT-Hijacking）。现有基于训练的防御（如BCT）需要监督冗长的推理轨迹，成本随推理长度线性增长。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于：激活层一致性训练（ACT）作为一种无需标签的自监督防御方法，其机制（激活空间的线性偏移）为理解和设计更高效的对齐训练提供了新视角。ACT不依赖CoT内容监督，这对于保护推理模型具有特殊价值。
summary.technical_approach: 对比两种一致性训练变体：输出级（BCT，用交叉熵监督完整输出分布）和激活级（ACT，在共享token位置监督内部隐藏状态一致性）。ACT的关键设计是找到clean prompt和wrapped prompt之间的共享后缀位置（通常是聊天模板的结束标记等约6个token），在这些位置上最小化激活差异，无需监督CoT内容。同时加入良性prompt的损失项来缓解性能退化。
summary.experiments: 在5个推理模型家族（越狱和prompt注入两种设置）上测试。在3个prompt注入基准和自适应RL攻击者上，ACT匹配或超过BCT。ACT对自适应攻击的鲁棒性更强，同时保持可比的模型效用。机制分析发现ACT的防御效果编码为激活空间中近似线性的偏移——可以通过单一方向向量控制（添加该方向诱导拒绝，移除则恢复顺从），且在CoT被替换为未防御模型的顺从轨迹时仍保持鲁棒。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点看Section 3的ACT方法论实现和机制洞察部分。特别关注共享后缀位置的确定方式和线性方向发现的实验。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。对预训练研究员有价值的延伸思考是：类似的激活一致性技术能否用于改善pretrain→SFT的对齐效率。
summary.authors_note: 引用了Irpan等人(2024)的ACT原始工作，具体作者和机构未在提供内容中标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Reasoning models with extended chain-of-thought (CoT) exhibit new vulnerability surfaces against adversarial jailbreaks and prompt injection—the CoT itself becomes an attack channel (e.g., H-CoT, CoT-Hijacking). Existing training-based defenses like BCT require supervising lengthy reasoning traces, with cost scaling linearly with inference length.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, activation-level consistency training (ACT) offers a label-free self-supervised defense whose mechanism (a linear shift in activation space) provides a new perspective on designing more efficient alignment training. ACT's independence from CoT content supervision is particularly valuable for protecting reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Compares two consistency training variants: output-level (BCT, cross-entropy supervision over full output distribution) and activation-level (ACT, supervision of internal hidden state agreement at shared token positions). ACT's key design is finding shared suffix positions between clean and wrapped prompts (typically ~6 chat-template tokens), minimizing activation differences at these positions without supervising CoT content. A benign prompt loss term mitigates performance degradation.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across five reasoning model families in both jailbreak and prompt injection settings. On three prompt injection benchmarks and an adaptive RL attacker, ACT matches or outperforms BCT. ACT shows stronger robustness against adaptive attacks while maintaining comparable model utility. Mechanistic analysis finds ACT's defense is encoded as an approximately linear shift in activation space controllable via a single direction vector (adding induces refusal, subtracting restores compliance), and remains robust even when the model's CoT is replaced with a compliant trace from an undefended model.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-read, focusing on Section 3 (ACT methodology implementation) and the mechanistic insight section. Pay special attention to shared suffix position determination and the linear direction discovery experiments. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes. A valuable extension for pretraining researchers is whether similar activation consistency techniques can improve pretrain-to-SFT alignment efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: Cites Irpan et al. (2024) for the original ACT work; specific authors and institutions not labeled in the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 对抗训练的后训练方法探索，激活空间线性偏移的机制发现值得关注，重点看§4的机制分析。
recommendation.en: Post-training method exploration for adversarial training; the linear activation shift mechanism finding is noteworthy, focus on Section 4.

paper.title: Beyond a Single Direction: Chain-of-Thought Disrupts Simple Steering of Refusal
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) generate chain-of-thought (CoT) traces before producing final outputs, introducing a dynamic internal state that may complicate control mechanisms such as refusal. Unlike instruction-tuned LLMs, where refusal is mediated by a single directional subspace, refusal in large reasoning models (LRMs) additionally depends on the CoT.
